nodes.label: Roadmap ideas (88 ranked gaps)
nodes.rationale: Written 2026-09-10 after the first live sync; ten lens-specific idea finders produced 116 raw ideas, merged to 88, each audited against the code and attacked by a skeptic. None of the 88 was already implemented.

nodes.label: Ten-lens idea finding, audit and skeptic method
nodes.rationale: Each idea was audited against real files (missing/partial, touches, house-rule hazards) and refuted by a skeptic scoring value and MV3 feasibility 1-5, so entries are leads with evidence, not decisions.

nodes.label: Tier 0a: make what exists trustworthy
nodes.rationale: Needs nothing from Sushi; all 13 items landed 2026-09-10 (388 to 546 tests).

nodes.label: Tier 0b: beta prerequisites that need Sushi
nodes.rationale: Each needs a capture, a decision or a tester before it can start.

nodes.label: Tier 1: highest value after the beta, no spec change
Tier 2: bigger bets or need a decision first
nodes.rationale: Each needs a §0/§1 decision or a new permission first.

nodes.label: G5: store submission after G4
nodes.rationale: Privacy policy URL, four screenshots, version bump, registry URL, submit; gated behind G4 per §9.

nodes.label: Rejected ideas (I86, I88)
nodes.rationale: Library loans need a non-illinois.edu host and content script; a day-7 check-in card duplicates a DM to ten hand-picked testers.

nodes.label: Theme: parsers capture more than the UI shows
nodes.rationale: Exam room, duration, release times, the PL credit ladder, not-for-credit, Canvas late/excused and timeAssumed all sit in RawItem.extra read only by tests, so the cheapest wins are display-only.

nodes.label: Theme: health is honest only inside the popup
nodes.rationale: A fresh store seeded every source ok before any fetch (defaultStatus), the status line said Synced when all failed (lastSyncAt set unconditionally), and no signal existed outside an extension page.

nodes.label: Theme: no notion of change over time
nodes.rationale: No diff between syncs, no moved/new marker, and a fired reminder is never re-armed when the deadline moves.

nodes.label: Theme: two sources can never say done
nodes.rationale: Course-site rows are status unknown forever and Canvas paper items stay not_submitted until graded, so finished work sits red for seven days with Hide as the only escape.

nodes.label: Theme: growth is gated on logged-in captures
nodes.rationale: Adapters two and three, the Canvas term filter, the non-PL home page and every Tier 2 source each start with a fixture only Sushi or a tester can produce.

nodes.label: Decision 1: Google Calendar OAuth sync now or v1.1
nodes.rationale: Needs an OAuth client, the identity permission and a rewording of 'nothing leaves the browser'.

nodes.label: Decision 2: is §0 decision 1 negotiable in wording
nodes.rationale: storage.sync (I53) and a Drive-published feed (I70) both work technically and both break 'nothing leaves the browser' as written.

nodes.label: Decision 3: content scripts on host pages, yes or no
nodes.rationale: I76, I77, I52, I87 all add scripting/activeTab and change the privacy story from reads to modifies.

nodes.label: Decision 4: manual deadline entry, aggregator or planner
nodes.rationale: Also removes the pressure that produces broken-page reports and adapters.

nodes.label: Decision 5: campus rows without a course
nodes.rationale: Registrar deadlines and final exam times are public and verified live, but a course-less row is a scope expansion from course deadlines.

nodes.label: Decision 6: snooze amends §7's daily booking nag

I17 · Health-aware popup empty state; no green dot before success
nodes.rationale: A fresh install showed four green dots and 'Not synced yet' — green before a single fetch, exactly worker rule 2's 'green means I did not fetch'. Objection: the popup syncs on open so the window is seconds.

nodes.label: I16 · Honest status line and stale-data banner
nodes.rationale: 'Synced 10:32' printed whenever the loop ran even if all four sources failed; Gradescope sessions expire and the source keeps old rows on failure by design, so the list looks healthy while new deadlines are silently absent.

nodes.label: I03 · Toolbar badge: today's count, red ! when a source is broken
nodes.rationale: §0 rule 3 says fail loudly but the only red/yellow dot rendered inside the popup; the first live run's 'site: ok (0 items)' cost two rounds because nobody was looking. Badge decision lives in core/badge.ts, worker only calls chrome.action.

nodes.label: I27 · 'Can reminders reach you?' check and test-reminder button
nodes.rationale: One click on 'Turn off notifications' sets the extension's level to denied and every reminder is created and dropped silently; denied must be its own colour, never green.

nodes.label: I38 · Coalesce catch-up reminder bursts, word by real remaining time
nodes.rationale: Laptop closed since Tuesday, opened Thursday 08:30 with HW due 09:00: both 24h and 2h leads are overdue and fire, the 24h one titled 'due tomorrow'. Marking a never-fired lead as fired invents a value — record it as superseded.

nodes.label: I01 · Deadline moved / new markers, notification, reminder re-arm
nodes.rationale: Per-student extensions and mid-week schedule edits are routine. Compare stated instants only: a timeAssumed 23:59 flipping to a stated time is not a move. Item.id hashes member keys so any merge or split would read as NEW/moved.

nodes.label: I04 · Late / reduced-credit window stays live after dueAt
nodes.rationale: PHYS 435 HW2 due Wed 5 PM is accepted until Sep 16; on Sep 10 the popup says '1d ago' and plans no reminder for the late deadline. Existing tests pin today's behaviour and must be rewritten quoting §4.3.

nodes.label: I07 · Reduced-credit ladder shown before the deadline passes
nodes.rationale: JSON.parse of creditSchedule in the UI must never throw; validate each tier positively. Skeptic: the actionable line is I04's '80% until Sep 22' wording.

nodes.label: I06 · Show runner-assumed 23:59 times as assumed
nodes.rationale: Every CS 424 row reads 11:59 PM although the schedule prints only a date; every dueAt consumer must check the flag. Sorting lives in dedupe.sortItems, not grouping.

nodes.label: I22 · Honest .ics / calendar link (all-day for invented times)
nodes.rationale: A calendar entry at 11:59 PM looks more authoritative than a list row. members.some(timeAssumed) is wrong for merged rows: dedupe picks the first stated member's dueAt, so the flag must track the chosen member.

nodes.label: I41 · Morning toast instead of 2h lead for runner-invented times
nodes.rationale: If CS 424's real cutoff is 5 PM, 'due in 2 hours' on an invented 23:59 fires at 9:59 PM. Affects only members whose sole source is a site adapter.

nodes.label: I08 · Local Done check-off, separate from Hide
nodes.rationale: Course-site rows are emitted status unknown and Canvas LTI shells have submission_types none, so two sources can never say done. A local done flag ORed into isItemDone hides a row even if Gradescope later flips it to missing — needs a rule for that.

nodes.label: I62 · Practice / not-for-credit tagging and demotion
nodes.rationale: Half of CS 357's assessments are NOT FOR CREDIT and sit in Needs attention indistinguishable from HW3. Default-off reminders contradict §4.3's warning that some such surveys are required.

nodes.label: I31 · Surface parser data-quality flags instead of dropping rows
nodes.rationale: House rule 1 keeps a row whose date failed to parse, but sectionFor returns undefined for a row without an instant, so the popup shows it nowhere — the §11 silent-empty path live today.

nodes.label: I43 · Split Options into Settings and a hidden Developer panel
nodes.rationale: The privacy pitch is 'never sees your password' and the first settings screen asked for name and NetID twice under a title saying debug. The site state/lastError must survive the removed row.

nodes.label: I59 · Lift backoff and resync immediately on extension update
nodes.rationale: §11's mitigation for a redesign is 'fix fast with a store update', but onInstalled syncs for every reason and runSync honours backoff for anything but manual; which states to clear is a core decision.

nodes.label: I49 · Adapter date grammar matching real fa26 pages
nodes.rationale: Live strings such as 'Due Friday, September 4 at 18:00 US Central time' are unparseable in every format, and M/d formats ignore the tail so '@ 11:59pm' silently becomes an assumed 23:59. Anchor both ends; one unrealistic fixture row per token.

nodes.label: I54 · Versioned store migrations with memberKey remapping
nodes.rationale: The maintainer will ship fixes to stores he cannot reset; sourceId derivation has already changed once (PrairieTest). A remap must also rewrite raw keys, members[].sourceId and misses keys, not only overrides and notified.

nodes.label: I30 · One-click scrubbed diagnostics bundle
nodes.rationale: Browser round-trips are the scarce resource; with ten testers every 'it shows nothing' is three messages. Request counts exist nowhere in the store — SourceOutcome.requests is logged and dropped.

nodes.label: I61 · Right-click 'Report this page to Illini Dash'
nodes.rationale: The report flow exists but needs copy URL, open gear, scroll, paste. The hash is untrusted: validate https and allowed host before prefill.

nodes.label: I55 · Beta install kit: zip, install guide, unlisted-store decision
nodes.rationale: G5 is gated behind G4 so testers install a non-store build; an unlisted store is worse for the beta week because every mid-week fix waits on review.

nodes.label: I45 · Canvas concluded-course filter via include[]=term
nodes.rationale: enrollment_state=active leaks a year-old FA25 compliance course; courseSummaries is built from raw items so a filtered course must be persisted separately. No include[]=term capture existed, so no parser before the fixture.

nodes.label: I82 · Publisher-tool deadlines: name the host first
nodes.rationale: 66 of 66 CS 357 Canvas assignments are external_tool shells with no due_at. external_tool_tag_attributes.url is off-origin, so RawItem.url must stay on canvas.illinois.edu.

nodes.label: I46 · 'Not used by you' source state for PrairieLearn / PrairieTest
nodes.rationale: For a Gies student the honest state of PL is 'not enrolled' but syncPrairieLearn throws ParseError. Must key on a captured positive marker, never zero rows; PL's zero-instance check is a body regex with no test.

nodes.label: I44 · Canvas 'No date' section with LTI-shell explanation
nodes.rationale: Dated assignments also arrive from planner as assignment:{id}, so emitting all rows collides sourceIds — emit undated only. linkHeaderNext exists but FetchedPage has no headers, so pagination is not wired.

nodes.label: I05 · First-run onboarding page
nodes.rationale: A cold install does nothing visible. onInstalled also fires for update and chrome_update, so the page must gate on details.reason === install.

nodes.label: I13 · Reminder toasts with Open / Snooze / Done buttons
nodes.rationale: Snooze-until decision belongs in core/schedule.ts; the button handler must write through withStore. On macOS buttons hide behind the Options chevron and requireInteraction is not honoured.

nodes.label: I21 · Manual deadlines as a sixth 'manual' source
nodes.rationale: Adapter coverage will lag for a long time. A typed bare date must set timeAssumed and SOURCE_RANK must not let a manual time outrank Canvas. runSync iterates PLANS so an absent source is never visited but its keys never enter seenThisSync.

nodes.label: I24 · Registrar deadlines as shipped campus rows
nodes.rationale: Oct 16 drop-without-W is the most-missed date on campus and in no course tool. validateRegistry throws on anything but an adapters array, so 'same refresh path' overstates it; registrar dates are timeAssumed rows.

nodes.label: I60 · Page-aware popup: this course first, focus tab, auto-resync
nodes.rationale: Every row click is chrome.tabs.create so a session ends with duplicate tabs. Tab URLs are visible without the tabs permission only on hosts already permitted.

nodes.label: I25 · Final exam time and room from Course Explorer
nodes.rationale: Finals are the one deadline where being wrong is total. Plans cannot see store.raw, so knownCourses injection is new work; no source tells the student's section.

nodes.label: I02 · Exam-day card on PrairieTest rows (room, duration, format)
nodes.rationale: CBTF sessions split between Grainger 057 and DCL L410 and a real capture shows Quiz 1 moving rooms. Capture prints '50min' with no space — anchor the regex, never Number().

nodes.label: I37 · A partial PrairieLearn score is not 'done'
nodes.rationale: Any bar above 0% maps to graded, so a 40% retake-to-100 homework disappears and its reminders are silenced. Fixture bars are only 0%/100%, so a wrong implementation passes — add an unrealistic row.

nodes.label: I47 · Per-adapter health state and N->0 guard per course site
nodes.rationale: With two adapters and one redesigned, partial failure is recorded ok and syncSites deletes all site: keys before re-adding survivors — the failed adapter's rows vanish next sync.

nodes.label: I51 · In-options adapter workbench with 'Propose this adapter'
nodes.rationale: Authoring loop is one maintainer-hour per adapter. capture() uses looksLikeLoginUrl (URL only) while sync uses looksLoggedOut(status, url, body) — the workbench must use the latter.

nodes.label: I19 · Per-sync change log strip
nodes.rationale: A live silent move exists between the Sep 3 and Sep 10 PrairieTest captures. 'gone' must exclude failing, resting and disabled sources; applyRetention already returns purged and runSync discards it.

nodes.label: I28 · Keep reminders working past Chrome's 500-alarm cap
nodes.rationale: planNotifications has no horizon so December's items are armed in September; past 500 alarms.create rejects mid-loop with no UI change. The cap decision belongs in planNotifications, not a try/catch in background.

nodes.label: I57 · Term rollover: term dates in the registry, Expired section
nodes.rationale: currentTermCode is a pure month rule: on Jan 1 every fa26 adapter disappears and syncSites throws SourceDisabled.

nodes.label: I40 · CBTF reservation-window escalation and missed-reservation notice
nodes.rationale: Retaining a raw item the source no longer reports cuts against the per-source atomic replace and the N->0 guard — decide where the ghost lives.

nodes.label: I42 · Google Calendar sync via chrome.identity
nodes.rationale: A moved deadline is the case .ics cannot handle. getAuthToken uses only the Chrome profile's account, and an @illinois.edu tenant may block unverified apps.

nodes.label: I53 · Sync settings and overrides via storage.sync
nodes.rationale: Overrides would ride Google's sync servers, so 'nothing leaves the browser' becomes false and listing text must change.

nodes.label: I70 · Subscribable .ics feed on the student's own Google Drive
nodes.rationale: §1 said a feed needs a server; the student's Drive is the server, but it uploads the list to a link-shared file and needs identity plus an OAuth client.

nodes.label: I76 · Content script writing due dates onto Canvas's dateless LTI rows
nodes.rationale: Matching Canvas titles to PL by tokens is exactly the false-merge risk G3 guards against.

nodes.label: I52 · Point-and-click selector picker on the live course page
nodes.rationale: A two-click generator emits nth-child selectors, which parser house rule 3 forbids.

nodes.label: I81 · smartPhysics prelectures and checkpoints (PHYS 211-214)
nodes.rationale: Verified live 2026-09-10 behind the ATLAS LAS-SSO gateway; items due 8:00 AM the day of lecture. Per-enrolment URL means a source, not an adapter (house rule 13).
